notes.outcome_correction: Original manifest written by the harness recorded outcome=complete because the check was based solely on submit response.is_success. The submit DID succeed (200) and queue lifecycle DID reach COMPLETED, but the response_url fetch returned HTTP 422 with a FastAPI invalid_parameter envelope ('Image resolution only support [128, 5000]') because the synthetic 1x1 PNG fixture was below Hunyuan3D's minimum input size. After the harness was patched to compute outcome from fetch status (commit-pending), this manifest was hand-corrected to validation_failed. The fixture was then bumped to 256x256 (commit 850c228); the successful run is captured in p4/.
